newsitem.title: USA: Unitrin agrees to buy Union Automobile.
newsitem.headline: Unitrin agrees to buy Union Automobile.

text.p: Unitrin Inc said Tuesday it had agreed to acquire Union Automobile Indemnity Co, the second recent acquisition of a property and casualty insurer by the Unitrin group.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals, Unitrin said.
The direct premiums written for Bloomington, Ill.,-based Union Auto for the 12 months ended September 30, 1996, were $37 million, Unitrin said.
The other recent acquisition by Unitrin was Milwaukee Insurance Group in October 1995. Unitrin is a property and casualty insurance company.
